title: 熱氧化閘極介電層
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 界面與氧化目的
stages.description: 在「界面與氧化目的」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for interface and oxidation purpose, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 分辨成長與沉積
steps.objective: 完成「分辨成長與沉積」的因果圖，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：分辨成長與沉積。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate growth and deposition. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「分辨成長與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate growth and deposition and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「分辨成長與沉積」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate growth and deposition: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

Interpretation: The original surface differs from the final silicon-oxide interface. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. steps.check: 交付「界面位置移動」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
